parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL identifier as molecule_chembl_id, molecule name as molecule_name, max phase as max_phase, molecule type as molecule_type, and canonical SMILES as canonical_smiles. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then join docs on doc_id. Optionally join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES, allowing nulls. Filter by document ChEMBL identifier CHEMBL4257575. Sort by molecule ChEMBL identifier ascending.
